texts.en:
You realize that your mission will be a bit more complicated than anticipated when the morgue supervisor responds to your question in the negative.

“No, I haven’t received a corpse matching your description in months. Besides, I must admit that lately, it has been very calm. The only body that I received last night was this worker that was crushed by a girder. Look at his thick, dirty, black nails. I have never seen anything like that before. This city never ceases to amaze me.”
